19.   `external_body` trust gap means the implementation's correctness depends
20.   on no overflow occurring.

186. }

200.     if self.capacity == 0 { return; }
201.     if btreemap_contains_key(&self.entries, &key) {
202.         btreemap_remove(&mut self.entries, &key);
203.     }
204.     if self.entries.len() >= self.capacity {
205.         self.evict();
206.     }
207.     self.counter += 1;
